The '''''Harbinger''''' was an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] that was in service with the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] as of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] in [[41 ABY]]. The warship participated in the [[Second Battle of Roche]] and was assaulted during the attack by forces of the [[Jedi Coalition]] and [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]]. The attack, which resulted in the [[Warship/Legends|warship's]] destruction, was a cover to allow the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] to penetrate the defenses around [[Nickel One]], in order to kill [[Darth Caedus]].
